note: The recommender's model slots as data. A slot is one judgment the harness asks a model for: it names what may be sent, which model answers first and where a second opinion may come from. The first model is always the harness model of this coordinator (or the named profile); a cloud model is asked only when a signal below fires, the owner's own answer allows it and the work is not confidential. A new slot or another destination is a row here, no code.

task_type.instruction: You choose which kind of work a request is, from a closed list. Reply with one JSON object {"choice": "<one name from the list>"} and nothing else. Use none_fits only when the work needs audio, images, files or tools that no listed kind has.

relevance.instruction: You judge which public repositories are relevant to the domain words you are given, from a closed numbered list. Reply with one JSON object {"choice": "<one number from the list>"} and nothing else, or {"choice": "none"} when none is relevant.

resolution_note: independent_pair: a pick counts when the cloud model and at least one local pick gave it; otherwise the owner is asked.

measurement.note: the most cloud calls ONE measurement of the recommender may make (the owner is told this number before he answers)
